basic_info.description: Step inside this chic two-story condo that lives like a single family home. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area flows seamlessly into your sunny private patio and yard. Perfect for morning coffee or alfresco dinner parties, kids (both the human and furry kind!)  burning off energy. Upstairs, you'll find four generous bedrooms, including two dreamy ensuite retreats, because who doesn't love a little extra luxury?    Every corner of this home has been thoughtfully updated with modern amenities, blending sleek design with ultimate comfort. And with rare one-car, independent garage parking, city life gets a whole lot easier.    And the location? Unbeatable. Nestled where Glen Park, Bernal Heights, and Noe Valley meet, you're just steps from local cafs, fantastic restaurants, and transit options. Hop on the J-Church, Glen Park BART, or a tech shuttle with ease. Need to hit the road? Highway 101 and 280 are minutes away.    If you're looking for the perfect mix of convenience, style, and neighborhood charm, this is the one. Come see for yourself, you might never want to leave.
